title: CreateVersionRequest
description: POST {RATEL_BASE_URL}/sandboxes/versions with a project key. It creates a version of an agent from an image tarball.

dirty.description: Whether the folder of ratel.yaml has changes that are not committed.

repository.description: The GitHub repository of the commit (`ratel push --ci`).

branch.description: The branch: a pull request's head branch, else the pushed branch.

pullRequest.description: The pull request number, or null for a push.

baseCommit.description: What the change compares against: the pull request's base, or the branch's previous head. Null for a new branch.

title.description: The pull request's title, else the first line of the commit message.

author.description: The GitHub login of the author.

diff.description: `git diff <baseCommit>...<commit>`, at most 512 KiB (the push body is at most 1 MiB). Left out with no base, or when it is larger (then diffTruncated).

diffTruncated.description: True when the diff was over 512 KiB and was left out.

bundle.description: The gzip of `docker save` that the upload step sends.
